'''Zollet Ventor''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] from [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. She worked as an archivist in the [[Royal Library of Alderaan/Legends|Royal Library of Alderaan]], along with her [[Marriage/Legends|husband]] [[Ean Ventor]]. Their son, [[Halagad Ventor]], became a protégé of the [[Noble/Legends|nobleman]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]]. In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], the [[House of Organa/Legends|House of Organa]] sent Zollet and Ean Ventor as their official representatives for the annual [[Grand Alderaanian Gathering]], which took place on the island of [[Okonomo]]. However, the genetics terrorist [[Zeta Magnus]] was present at the party, hoping to get revenge on an [[Arkanian/Legends|Arkanian]] [[Unidentified Arkanian matron|matron]]. Magnus unleashed a [[hive virus]] that drove all attendees mad, prompting them to jump at each other's throat and start devouring each other. The Ventor spouses [[Death/Legends|died]] in that incident, which was later known as the [[Okonomo Tragedy]].<ref name="swcw" />
